hero.title: Watch, Learn, and Play, All in One App!
hero.description: Empower your child with Cambodia’s leading educational app. Featuring certified lessons and interactive games for the next generation of learners.

kid_feature_section.title: Discover The Fun!
kid_feature_section.description: Our interactive curriculum grows with your child, making every lesson a rewarding adventure.

watch.title: Watch
watch.description: Access hundreds of fun, educational videos that make learning feel like play. We take safety seriously—that’s why our core content is officially certified by MoEYS, giving you the confidence that your child is learning from the best resources in Cambodia.

learn.title: Learn
learn.description: Our interactive exercises cover reading, writing, and listening. Best of all, our curriculum is designed in harmony with Ministry of Education, Youth and Sport (MoEYS) standards, providing a professional-grade education through a playful, modern interface that kids actually love to use.

play.title: Create & Play
play.description: Our Play feature is a digital playground where imagination knows no bounds. Whether it’s painting a masterpiece with our vibrant coloring tools, drawing from scratch, or exploring educational mini-games, your child is building more than just art—they’re building confidence. It’s the perfect way to encourage self-expression and creative thinking in a safe, mess-free environment!

parent_feature_section.title: Stay in the Loop!
parent_feature_section.description: Monitor your child's progress with real-time reports and insights into their growth.

parental_dashboard.title: Parental Dashboard
parental_dashboard.description: Gain full visibility into your child’s journey. Track their Watch history and favorites, monitor Learn progress, and see their creative activity in the Play feature—all in one place.

download_section.title: Start Your Child’s Adventure Today
download_section.description: Join thousands of children learning the fun way with Chlat.

section_1.title: Build Digital Infrastructures
section_1.description: to enable learning in Primary Education entertaining, empowering and accessible for children through the power of technology.

section_2.title: We make learning fun...
section_2.description: fun is our foundation. We use the power of play to make complex lessons simple and interactive. By turning primary education into an engaging digital experience, we ensure that every child stays motivated to learn, explore, and grow.

section_3.title: Safe Screens, Happy Parents
section_3.description: Your child’s safety is our highest priority. Our platform is built to be a "walled garden"—a secure space where everything is checked and verified. Through our parental dashboard, you stay in total control, allowing you to relax while your child explores a world of learning designed specifically for their age and culture.
